chase: Oh, you came straight down my hallway. Lovely.
Sprint all you like. The doorway knows where you're going.
Keep running. Every hall here ends in a surprise.
There's a door behind you. It isn't the door you think.
Come on, runner. Tell me you didn't see that gap.
Hurry up. I want to see you walk into it.
Run faster. The next doorway is already waiting for you.
You keep choosing the open doorway. How sweet.
Slow down, runner. The floor is still deciding.
Left, right, then straight into the one I painted.
They always run for the open door. Every single time.
Round the bend, and mind the thin line in the air.
You went left, and the left wall is the one I wired.
Nice try at the corner. I'd already painted that corner.
Runner's going round the back. Let them. Wires are waiting.
You lot take the chase. I'll keep the frame.
Ring the bell if you want me to follow. Quick.
I'm right behind you, bell and all.
Doorway ahead. I'll ring when I'm through it.
catch: Caught you. Don't struggle, it only makes the bell louder.
Got you, and the stun will last a while.
You're stuck now. Such a sensible place to stop.
Caught. Stand right there while I tidy up the hall.
Gotcha. You walked straight into my little surprise.
Stop wriggling. You'll only pull the wire tighter.
Hands where I can see them, and nobody gets hurt.
Got you at the doorway. Right where I planned.
Caught in my own trap. Your ankle, my wire. Fair.
You're a lot of fuss for one doorway. Caught.
Bells are ringing. Somebody will come and get you.
Stay down a moment. The stun wears off soon enough.
Got one. The others will be along for the bells.
Thank you for stopping. That was the hard part.
One of yours just walked into my wire. Lovely timing.
Caught you on the landing. Ding, ding, done.
Still now. The bell is almost silent.
Got you, and the little bell says so too.
hear: There it is. Did you hear the little bell?
Bells ring down the hall, and everyone comes to look.
Gather round the bell. I think they're close.
Someone's running on the loose boards. Let's go see.
That bang came from the stairwell. Somebody's been careless.
A door just slammed. I'll go check the frame.
Something broke in the back hall. Could be a runner.
I heard that shout. It came from behind the bookcase.
Footsteps near the vent. Mind the wires on the way.
A crash in the lounge. Let's see who made it.
Somebody's fumbling with a latch down there. Coming.
Quiet footsteps by the copy room. Quiet ones are the worst.
Whoever knocked that over, I'm coming to ask.
Something rattled a door in the far hall. Going now.
Hear that? Something is moving near the fire. Going.
A bell rang softly down the stairs. Listen.
Somebody tugged a wire near the door. Going.
I hear your heels tapping. Ding, you're close.
search: You lost me at the bend. I'll let you feel clever.
Went quiet, did you? The doors are still open, though.
Where did you go? Walls don't keep secrets forever.
Nothing on the wire. Back to the rooms, then.
You slipped past the frame. I'll check every door again.
Gone quiet. Quiet runners get tired, I think.
Right, then left, then nothing. Time to count doors again.
The bells are silent. So are you. Very clever.
I'll walk the hall once more, slowly, looking at frames.
Lost you around the corner. Back to my rounds, then.
No footsteps now. Time to check under the dust sheets.
You can't hide forever behind a painted door.
I'll lift every dust sheet until I find you.
Nobody in sight. Back to patrol, and I'll keep watching.
Gone for now. I know you'll try the next doorway.
stunned: Wires don't hurt anyone. They just make you stop.
Give me a second. My ankle decided to sit down.
Ugh, that wire was tied tighter than I left it.
Stunned, but not for long. I'm already shaking it off.
My hands are numb. Lovely, that's a first for me.
Right, I'm standing again. Mostly. Give it a second.
That crowbar hurt more than my pride. Almost.
That zap is buzzing in my arm. Give me a moment.
That axe hit my shoulder hard. Give me a moment.
Shaking it off. My legs will remember this for a while.
Still stuck. Let me count to three and try again.
Stunned by a wire. I'll make sure that's the last one.
I'm recovering. Please don't run in circles while I do.
Sparks in my eyes. Nothing I haven't walked through before.
Hold still a second. The shaking will pass.
hide_spot: You hid, and I still heard you breathing in the frame.
Hiding behind a door? Clever. I hang doors for a living.
Locker, bed, or wardrobe. I check them all, every time.
Cozy spot you found. Shame it's on my list.
Under the bed again. How predictable of you.
That locker door shut very nicely. It still squeaks, though.
You're hiding behind a painted door. I'd know it anywhere.
I'm walking past, very slowly. Stay exactly where you are.
Not that doorway. The one beside it. There you are.
The closet door is ajar. Lovely. Come out, please.
Hold your breath, runner. I can hear the bed creak.
I'll pass your hiding spot twice. Once for luck.
Behind the curtain. Oldest trick in the house.
Your bed is very tidy. Too tidy for hiding in.
I'm opening the wardrobe now. Surprise, it's me.
light: Point that flashlight at the floor. You'll see my wire.
Your flashlight just showed me exactly where you stand.
Lights on. Good. I like a room I can read.
Ow, that beam is in my eyes. Aim it somewhere else.
Rude to dazzle people. Turn that flashlight away, please.
Blinding me won't help you. I know this hall by heart.
Bright. Very bright. Could you point it at the ceiling?
My eyes are full of spots. Lovely. Thanks for that.
Stop waving the flashlight. You'll wake the bells.
You've lit up the whole corridor for me. Thank you.
Turn off the lamp, runner. It's just giving you away.
Careful with that beam. It shows me the wires.
Dazzled by you, which is not how I planned my evening.
Oh, that's bright. Keep it on me and I'll find you faster.
Dazzled again. Honestly, you're making this too easy.
idle: Don't look at the floor. The floor is looking at you.
I paint doors on the walls. Shut, open, or pretending.
A painted door is still a door. That's what makes it work.
Half the trick is paint. Nobody reads the grain.
Doors are just rooms that lie about where they lead.
A good fake door needs a good brass handle. Trust me.
I like a door that has no business being there.
Somebody left a flashlight on in my hall again.
Stay out of my doorways, please. I'm working.
Dust sheets, a plank, a loose hinge. Lovely materials.
I count everything out loud. Seven steps. Seven doors.
Mind the wire, you two. It's mine, not yours.
I'm painting the stairs blue. Stairs are always cold.
Build it, paint it, then wait for someone to try the handle.
Give me a list of rooms and I'll give you a staircase.
ability: Each wire you cross makes me a little quicker. Permanently.
Walk into a wire and you'll stay put for a moment.
Two wires at a time. Usually one is enough.
I'm faster every time you step through a doorway.
Stun first, chase second. That's the whole trick here.
A wire in the air, a bell at each end. Easy to miss.
Doorways always make people hesitate. Don't hesitate.
I hang a fake door and wait for someone to try it.
Every corridor is a trap if you're in a hurry.
Wires go where the hall pinches. Nowhere else.
My wires cross the whole hall. Crouching won't save you.
Pull a wire and the bells ring. Nearby hunters come to look.
Cross a wire and I know exactly where you are.
Cross a wire and you lose a moment. I'll take the rest.
Trip one and I stay locked on you. Enjoy the view.
mechanic: Oh, you cut my wire. That noise was rude, you know.
Whoever cut that wire, you're on bell duty now.
Someone on your side just cut my wire. Be quick.
Every wire I've spent still sits there, waiting.
Wires reset slowly. Give them thirty seconds and they're back.
A cut wire rattles the bells. Everybody hears that.
Don't hold that door for them. It's a trap.
Keep your eyes forward. Backward is where the bells are.
You stopped right in front of my line. Thank you.
Stop at the wire? No? Then I'll see you there.
Vents are lovely, but a crawl is a slow way to run.
Radar blips are useful. Shame yours tells on you.
Relays hum near the bells. Stay clear of them, runner.
Items on the floor are bait. Leave anything near a wire.
Take the stairs slowly. The third step creaks for everyone.
Cutting a wire takes a moment. Be quick about it.
The bell circuit's in the attic. Mind the wire.
Batteries power the bells. Don't let them run dry.
Relay's live under the stairs. Ring when fixed.
